title: By hand: parallel edges pile up
notes: Contract A-B and then A-C: the super-vertex {A, B, C} now has three edges to D, one from each of its members. Contraction keeps them all, as parallel edges, and that is what makes a big group likely to stay together.
ops: A-B, A-C, B-C, B-D, C-D, A-D, D-E, E-F, E-G, F-G, F-H, G-H, E-H
